CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Psalm of David.
CHAPTER.VERS: O Jehovah, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy hill?
He who walks uprightly, and works righteousness, and speaks the truth in his heart;
he who does not backbite with his tongue, nor does evil to his neighbor, nor takes up a reproach against his friend;
in whose eyes the reprobate is despised, but he honors those who fear Jehovah; he has sworn to his hurt, and does not change it;
he has not put out his money at interest, nor has he taken a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be moved.
